source_text: Ὁ πρῶτος λαός, ὁ ἐκ περιτομῆς" ,,ἰσχύς μου καὶ ἀρχὴ τέχνων μου", καϑὼς ὑπέσχετο ὃ ϑεὸς «τῷ ᾿Αβραὰμ τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ. ,,σκληρὸς δὲ φέρεσθαι“, ἐπειδὴ παρεσκληρύνϑη ὃ λαὸς πρὸς τὴν ὑπαχοὴν τοῦ ϑεοῦ. ,καὶ σκληρὸς αὐϑάδης“, ὅτι οὐ μόνον σκληρὸς πρὸς τὴν ὑπακοὴν τοῦ ϑεοῦ, ἀλλ᾽ ὅτι κεὰ «αὐϑάδης ἐγένετο πρὸς τὸ χεῖρας ἐπιβαλεῖν τῷ χυρίῳ. ,,ἐἐξύβρισας“, ἐπειδὴ διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐξύβοισεν ὃ λαὺς τὸν πατέρα. «μὴ ἐκζέσῃς" δὲ λέγει τὸ πνεῦμα παρακλητικῶς, ἵνα μὴ τέλεον ἐχζέσας ὑπερχυϑῇ, ἐλπίδα δὲ δοὺς αὐτῷ σωτηρίας τὸ γὰρ ἐκζέσαν καὶ ἐκχυϑὲν ἀπόολέτο. (ἀνέβης γὰρ ἐπὶ τῆς κοίτης τοῦ πατρός σου“ πρῶτον μὲν τὸ συμβὰν λέγει, ὅτι ἐπ᾿ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν μέλλει ὁ λαὸς ἐπιβουλεύειν τῇ κοίτῃ τοῦ πατρός, τουτέστι τῇ νύμφῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ, πρὸς τὸ βούλε σϑαι αὐτὴν διαφϑεῖραι" ὅπερ καὶ πράττει μέχρι καὶ τήμερον ἐπιβουλεύων αὐτῇ διὰ τῶν βλασφημιῶν.
pass_a_gloss: The first people, the ones from circumcision, are my strength and the beginning of my skills, as God promised to Abraham and to his seed. But they are hard to bear, since the people were hardened towards the obedience of God. And they are hard and self-willed, because they are not only hard towards the obedience of God, but also because they became self-willed towards laying hands on the Lord. You have insulted, since the people insulted the Father through our Lord Jesus Christ. Do not become completely hardened, the Spirit says in a encouraging way, so that having become completely hardened you may not be poured out, but giving him hope of salvation, for the one who becomes hardened and is poured out is lost. For it says you went up onto the bed of your father, first it says what happened, that in the last days the people will plot against the bed of the Father, that is the bride, the church, in order to plan to corrupt her, which they also do until today, plotting against her through blasphemies.

bible_refs.note: reference to Abraham and his seed

pass_b_english: The first people, the ones from circumcision, were my strength and the beginning of my endeavors, just as God promised to Abraham and to his seed (Genesis). Yet they have become hard to endure, since the people hardened themselves against obedience to God. They are stubborn and self-willed, not only resisting God's obedience but also becoming self-willed enough to lay hands on the Lord. You have insulted, because the people insulted the Father through our Lord Jesus Christ. "Do not become completely hardened," the Spirit says encouragingly, so that by becoming completely hardened you may not be poured out and lost, but instead receive hope of salvation; for whoever becomes hardened and is poured out perishes. Scripture says, "You went up onto your father's bed" (Genesis), and first it recounts what happened: in the last days the people will plot against the Father's bed -- that is, the bride, the Church -- intending to corrupt her, and they continue doing so even today, plotting against her through blasphemies.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Greek fragments. Pass A and Pass B both correctly handle the complex clauses regarding the hardening of the people and the metaphor of the 'bed of the father'. Scripture citations (Genesis) were added to the English to identify the allusions as required by the instructions.
